cn: ⭐AEE - 外觀編輯拓展 更新
新增網路衣櫃，提供300套服裝保存(但使用三方空間請自己評估)
新增圖層管理，並且支援快速訪問服裝編輯(含道具)
調整配合131的渲染機制，移除位移、旋轉、縮放的渲染機制，僅做編輯處理
調整配合131的機制，現在能對玩偶進行縮放等編輯
調整自由繪圖的繪製結果保存機制，現在能更自由的繪圖(但使用三方空間請自己評估)
調整因應自由繪圖保存機制調整，設置頁提供關閉功能，如果對功能有疑慮可自行關閉，但同時也看不到他人繪圖效果
調整預覽角色功能已經支援在換裝當下即時切換
現在變形與鏡射仍是由AEE渲染，並且自由繪圖與單手套也是只有AEE用戶才能看到效果，使用時請自己評估
⭐LCE - 俱樂部拓展 更新
新增即時通信的按鈕API暴露
調整因131的更新的分層面版適配
調整防作弊機制更加健壯
調整線上資料編輯功能移至偏好設定並提供匯出與匯入功能
修改查詢插件時如果禁止就不該被查到
⭐MAT - 機械翻譯 更新
新增翻譯的摺疊功能，可以還原原句子而不是重新翻譯回去
新增略過🌐、🔊的信息過濾功能(代表收不到MAT與ECHO翻譯)
修改對LSCG的Action信息翻譯(不一定穩定)
⭐BC_ChatRoomButtons 更新
因應要求將信息發送鍵補回，但替換ICON，並且提供自己編輯順序
en: ⭐ AEE - Appearance editing extension Update
Added online wardrobe with support for saving up to 300 outfits (please evaluate third-party storage usage at your own discretion).
Added layer management, with quick access to clothing editing (including props).
Adjusted rendering mechanism to align with update 131; removed rendering for position, rotation, and scaling — now only handles editing operations.
Adjusted to accommodate the new 131 mechanics; dolls can now be scaled and edited accordingly.
Revised the save mechanism for freehand drawing results, allowing for more flexible drawing (third-party storage usage is at your own discretion).
Added a toggle in settings to disable the freehand drawing save feature due to the above changes — users with concerns may turn it off, but this will also hide others' drawing effects.
Preview character function now supports real-time switching during outfit changes.
Transformation and mirroring are still rendered by AEE. Freehand drawing and single glove effects are also only visible to AEE users — please evaluate before use.
⭐ LCE - Liko's Club Expansion Update
Exposed API for real-time communication button integration.
Adapted layer panel to accommodate update 131 changes.
Strengthened anti-cheat mechanisms.
Moved online data editing to preferences, with import/export support.
Modified plugin query behavior — if a plugin is banned, it should no longer be discoverable.
⭐ MAT - Messages Auto Translator Update
Added collapsible translation feature, allowing users to view the original sentence without retranslating it back.
Added message filtering to skip 🌐 and 🔊 markers (meaning MAT and ECHO translations will not be received for these messages).
Adjusted translation handling for LSCG Action messages (may not be fully stable).
⭐ BC_ChatRoomButtons Update
Restored the send message button as requested, with a new icon and the ability to customize button order.
